summary.text: Jeremy Stine is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 27, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Calcasieu Parish. First elected in 2021, Jeremy Stine chairs the Judiciary B Committee and the Capitol Security Council.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page, which lists the senator as Jeremy P. Stine, gives his education as a degree in political science and French from Louisiana State University.

The Senate page lists Jeremy Stine's committee assignments as Judiciary B (chair), Labor and Industrial Relations, Senate and Governmental Affairs, Finance (interim member), Capitol Security Council (chair), Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and Senate Executive Committee, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation (first vice chair).
